# WireMinute

> WireMinute is an online news agency publishing breaking news and live world updates every minute, in its own words. Coverage is international first: world, politics, business, technology, sports and health. Every story opens on wireminute.com with a real photo of its subject.

## News sections

- [Latest news](https://wireminute.com/): The newest stories across all sections, updated every minute
- [World](https://wireminute.com/world.html): International news, conflicts, diplomacy and major global events
- [Politics](https://wireminute.com/politics.html): Governments, elections, courts and policy
- [Business](https://wireminute.com/business.html): Markets, companies, trade and the global economy
- [Technology](https://wireminute.com/technology.html): Tech companies, AI, gadgets and science
- [Sports](https://wireminute.com/sports.html): Football, cricket, tennis, Formula 1 and more
- [Health](https://wireminute.com/health.html): Medicine, public health and research

## About WireMinute

- [About us](https://wireminute.com/about.html): What WireMinute is and how it works
- [Contact](https://wireminute.com/contact.html): How to reach the newsroom
- [Privacy policy](https://wireminute.com/privacy.html): How reader data is handled

## Feeds and discovery

- [RSS feed](https://wireminute.com/feed.xml): The latest original stories as an RSS feed
- [Sitemap](https://wireminute.com/sitemap.xml): Every page and story on the site
- [Facebook Page](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61596949581283): WireMinute stories posted through the day
